archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for Government/Trust and Accessibility

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Ensure all text has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background.
Use left-alignment for paragraphs, inputs, and dense content to maximize readability for older adults.
Line height must be 'leading-relaxed' for body text to aid vision-impaired reading.
Use #005EA2 (USWDS standard blue) for primary interactive elements.
Hover states must visibly darken the button and explicitly state the text color.
Focus states must use ring-2 ring-offset-2 with the #F59E0B (amber) or bright blue focus ring to ensure clear keyboard navigation visibility.
Do NOT rely on color alone to convey information; use icons alongside text.
Mobile-first responsive grids: start with grid-cols-1.
Keep containers constrained to max-w-5xl for optimal reading width.
Ensure interactive touch targets are a minimum of 44px in height.
Inputs and forms must have visible 1px borders, never relying purely on background color.

required_components: Table (optional, if using table layout for schedules)

specific_guidelines.buttons: Large touch targets (h-12 or h-14). Use solid primary color for main CTA, outline for secondary actions (Print, Download).
specific_guidelines.forms: Clear explicit labels above inputs. Large text (text-base or text-lg).
specific_guidelines.accordion: Use for FAQ section. Ensure the click target spans the entire row, not just the text or icon.
specific_guidelines.navigation: Sticky desktop header (z-50) with glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) and a solid bottom border (border-slate-200).
specific_guidelines.testing: MANDATORY: Every interactive element must have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='calculate-button').

images.placement: Hero section alongside the title, or as a visual anchor in the 'How it works' section.

images.alt: Elderly woman smiling while using a tablet at home
images.placement: Information section explaining how to use the portal, establishing trust and approachability.

rules: Images must have descriptive alt text for accessibility.
Apply rounded corners (rounded-2xl) to images to match the design system.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React application using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons (Calendar, Clock, CheckCircle, Info, Download, Printer, Copy, Share).
Install and import 'Outfit' and 'Work Sans' fonts via Google Fonts in the HTML/CSS.
Structure the page: Header -> Hero -> Calculator Form Card -> Result Card -> Upcoming Payments -> Information/How It Works -> FAQ Accordion -> Disclaimer Footer.
For the calculator, use Shadcn Select/Input for 'Birth Date' and 'Benefit Type'. No functional logic is required, just mock the UI states.
Implement the Result Card prominently with a mocked countdown and large bold text displaying the 'Next Payment Date'.
Include utility action buttons (Add to Calendar, Print, Share) styled as secondary outlines beneath the result.
Ensure all text color explicitly overrides any Tailwind defaults to guarantee WCAG AA contrast (e.g., text-slate-900 instead of text-gray-800).
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, links, and accordion triggers.
Do not use complex animations; use simple transitions (duration-200) for hover/focus states to respect older adults' usability needs.
